product_constraint: Exact complete state/output, configured maxima2/3, same-request 1.5x–3x committed Decode; joint Prefill, TTFT, Decode and total.

downward_budget.arithmetic_removed: 24 of 90 scalar multiply/add instructions per lane across six heads, before guard overhead. This is not a timing prediction and cannot alone establish target completion.

mechanism: Fuse each even BF16 product into its original first-level pair sum only when that product is exact, finite and nonzero FP32. Query guards hoisted over positions; four key guards shared over six heads. Warp-uniform original-path fallback preserves arbitrary inputs. All higher additions, warp trees, scale, softmax, PV and state unchanged.
proof: Require even-index operands unbiased exponent -63..63 (BF16 absolute bits 0x2000..0x5f7f); exclude zeros and all special values. Each product has <=16 significant bits, magnitude >=2^-126 and <=(255/128)^2*2^126, so exact finite nonzero FP32.
For exact nonzero p0, RN(RN(a0*b0+0)+p1) equals RN(a0*b0+p1). p1 remains the original fma(a1,b1,+0); no reassociation of any higher tree.
Excluding zero p0 avoids -0 from odd underflow changing the original +0 pair result. NaN propagation must pass directed raw-bit native tests, not be assumed from real algebra.
The runtime guard is the authority, not a historical activation distribution. No state flags, new workspace or allocations.
gates: Static no-spill check; directed raw pair and full probability/output guards.
P513 full-state transactions and P8192 complete prefixes against scalar.
Immediate d2 P65/8K/40K API; >3% slowdown or nonpositive 8K closes; useful long result unlocks d3.
expiry: First complete API return or rejection. No production promotion or qualification-only extension.
